subject: general
question: What is the main feature of the 106th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2023?

options.text: Reservation of one-third seats for women in legislatures
Provision of legal status to Right to Property

solution:
The correct answer is __**Reservation of one-third seats for women in legislatures**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **106th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2023** is a landmark legislation that provides for **reservation of one-third seats for women** in the Lok Sabha and State Legislatures.
 
• This amendment aims to promote **gender equality** and increase the representation of women in legislative bodies.
 
• The reservation will apply to seats in the **Lok Sabha** and State Legislative Assemblies, ensuring that a significant percentage of elected representatives are women.
 
• The amendment stipulates that the reservation will be implemented after the next delimitation exercise, which is based on the population census.
 
• This amendment is seen as a step towards empowering women politically and addressing the gender gap in decision-making bodies</strong&
